metadata.note: Modern-day Muni Metro network, as of the GTFS feed pulled from https://muni-gtfs.apps.sfmta.com/data/muni_gtfs-current.zip. Route geometry, frequency (headway_min, from real scheduled trip counts on a representative Wednesday), and avg_speed_kmh (from real scheduled trip duration) are all sourced directly from the agency's own GTFS feed, same methodology as data/amtrak.geojson. Each route is a single-year segment (2026) since GTFS has no historical depth. Historical segments (pre-2026) were added from SFMTA and Wikipedia sources. The J/K/L/M/N began as surface streetcar lines between 1917 and 1928; they survived Muni's 1948-49 conversion of most streetcar routes to buses precisely because they ran through tunnels and exclusive right-of-way buses could not use, and were moved into the Market Street Subway between 1980 and 1981 to become Muni Metro. The F is a 1995 heritage line and the T opened in 2007. Unlike the GTFS-sourced 2026 segment, the older headway_min values are estimates, not real timetables.
metadata.line_label_audit: 2026-08-24: line labels normalised repo-wide to "<operating company>: <line name>" -- the company's common display name (legal suffixes dropped), then the line as a passenger would have known it, or its two terminals where the line carried no advertised name. Long intermediate station lists were reduced to endpoints. For features spanning several operators the company shown is the one that ran the line for most of its drawn years. See CLAUDE.md Rule 6.
